dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent structures are visible along the dorsal ridge: a leftmost 'C' shape with a high-frequency, crenulated perimeter; a central irregular 'O' shape with a fragmented, thin boundary; and a right-side 'C' shape with a diffused gradient on the superior arc. All transition from dark-grey exterior to light-grey/white interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of high-intensity pixel clusters is observed, primarily in the posterior-dorsal region. These blobs lack an internal gradient and represent localized core concentrations of bright white pixels distinct from the linear mesh.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary macro-annuli form a wide obtuse triangle along the longitudinal axis. Additionally, three high-intensity blobs in the posterior region define a small scalene triangle relative to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex network of vermiculated, lower-contrast interlocking lines connects the primary macro-annuli across the central-lateral field.
